# MapCard

A 180px stylised map for the top of the confirmation card. The map settles in from 112% over 700ms, the pin pops, then the callout rises. It is drawn in CSS and shows no real place.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/mapcard)

## Usage

```tsx
<Card>
  <MapCard label="Shipping address" place="San Francisco CA" />
  <CardBody>…</CardBody>
</Card>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `ReactNode` | Small grey line in the callout. |
| `place` | `ReactNode` | Bold line in the callout. |
| `active` | `boolean` | Hold the entrance until true. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `MapCard.module.css`
- `MapCard.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
